name: foundry-qa
description: Web QA in code and with example users: a definition-of-done gate (deployed SHA check plus a Playwright journey on desktop, phone and tablet), blast-radius regression checks, axe-core accessibility audits against a WCAG 2.2 AA floor, screenshot baselines with pixel diff, and three agents (web-qa, a read-only persona-tester, and an exploratory crawler).
